# Architectural Digest India

> > India's premier architecture and design publication showcasing contemporary interiors, design events, and the intersection of traditional Indian craftsmanship with modern aesthetics.

Architectural Digest India features the AD Design Show (ADDS), an annual design exhibition celebrating Indian artisans and global design trends. The publication covers interior design styles, architecture projects, and cultural design movements across India and internationally.

## Key Topics

- AD Design Show (ADDS)
- Indian craftsmanship and artisans
- Karigar Pavilion
- Interior design styles (Japandi, Scandinavian, Boho, Industrial)
- Jodhpur and Lal Dera
- Mehrangarh Museum
- Contemporary Indian architecture
- Furniture exhibitions
- Brand showcases
- Midcentury modern design
- Bauhaus principles
- JSW Foundation
- Heritage design spaces
- Mughal Era influences

## Design Events & Exhibitions

- [ADDS 2023](https://events.architecturaldigest.in/): AD Design Show 2023 event in Jodhpur featuring Indian crafts at Lal Dera

## Interior Design Guides

- [8 popular interior design styles](https://www.architecturaldigest.in/web-stories/8-popular-interior-design-styles/): Guide to interior styles: boho, Japandi, Scandinavian, industrial & more
